verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Hoppscotch serves an llms.txt at docs.hoppscotch.io/llms.txt (HTTP 200). It contains a structured index of its documentation that an agent can be pointed at directly. Missing for 10: no first-party documentation describing or promoting the llms.txt / agent-oriented docs, no evidence of a full-content variant (e.g. llms-full.txt), and no independent corroboration of agents using it.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
